The editing prototype is at **http://maker:4001/edit.html** — three saved bookmarks, the third deliberately stuffed with very long text.

---

### 👉 Please try this

1. On the first bookmark (*Introducing Hooks*), click **✎ Edit**. Change the **title**, add or remove a **tag**, tweak the **description** and **note**, then click **Save changes** — the card updates with your edits. (Or click **Cancel** to back out.) This is how you'd fix up a link whose details couldn't be read, or just refine any bookmark.

2. Scroll to the **third** bookmark — the one with the enormous title, long description, five tags, and a rambling note. Check that everything **wraps neatly inside the card** and nothing spills off the edge, even with that much text.

---

Then I have **three short behaviour questions** where a description is clearer than a screen — just tell me yes or tell me what you'd prefer:

- **A** — When you save a brand-new link, should it start life in your **"To read"** pile by default (since you haven't read it yet)?
- **B** — For an **archived** bookmark: I've treated archived links as "put away," so to change one's read/unread status you'd **restore it first**, then mark it. Is that acceptable, or would you want to mark archived links as read/unread without restoring them?
- **C** — Your goal was to archive instead of deleting. Should the app have **no permanent delete at all** (archiving is the only way to remove something from view), or do you also want a way to delete a bookmark for good?
